Micron says over 75% of fiscal 2027 shipments are already committed, with customer allocation talks for fiscal 2028 and some supply deals extending past 2030, giving multi-year demand visibility.
Micron (MU) said DRAM average selling prices jumped about 140% year-over-year while DRAM volumes climbed roughly 30%, a mix that significantly boosted the company’s profitability during that period.
Micron will pay $600M in $30M quarterly installments (Q4 2026–Q3 2031), gain a five-year global license to Netlist server DIMM/HBM patents, and bought 10M Netlist shares.
